Package dev.px.core.config

Class Json

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.config.Json
public final class Json extends Object
The shared Gson instance and file helpers.

Pretty printing is on because configs are meant to be hand-editable; that was the one real virtue of the old plain-text format and it is worth keeping. Gson ships with the game on every version, so this adds no dependency.
